idea-plugin.name: YOLO: AI Agents Extender
idea-plugin.description:
YOLO is a standalone AI Agents panel for IntelliJ IDEA. It lists your AI CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy, Qoder, or your own) and lets you launch any of them in YOLO mode with a single click — no Terminal plugin required.

  • YOLO panel — A dedicated tool window (right side, y icon) that replicates the Terminal's AI Agents experience, built entirely on public IntelliJ APIs so it passes Marketplace verification.
  • YOLO mode — A "Skip permissions" toggle in the panel. When on, the next agent launches with its skip-permissions flag (e.g. --dangerously-skip-permissions, --yolo, -y). Per-agent, fully configurable, and off by default.
  • In-IDE console — Launching an agent opens it in a real PTY-backed console tab inside the YOLO panel, so the agent runs interactively without leaving the IDE.

⚠️ Warning — about "YOLO mode" / the skip-permissions flag: letting an AI agent run commands and edit files without confirmation can make irreversible changes, execute untrusted code, or expose your system. These risks come entirely from the agent and the bypass flag itself. This plugin only flips that flag for you — it adds no such behavior of its own, performs no actions on your behalf, and is not responsible for what the agent does. Enable YOLO mode only in trusted environments.
